# GJH Inc. — AI and data consulting
> A consulting firm helping organizations put AI and their data to practical use. Founded 2009. Anthropic partner.

GJH Inc. helps teams figure out where AI genuinely helps, build the systems that deliver it, and keep the data underneath in good order.

Work:
- Advisory — where AI is worth the effort in your organization, and where it isn't
- Building — assistants, automations, and internal tools that run against your real systems
- Data foundations — warehouses, pipelines, and models
- Staying with it — monitoring, tuning, and support after launch

How we work:
- We start small and paid — a short assessment of one workflow — so you can judge the work before committing to more. Most engagements begin under a month.
- Senior people do the work. You will not be handed to a team you have not met.
- You own everything we build: the code, the infrastructure, the documentation. No dependency on us by design.

Sectors:
- Financial services — banking, payments, and reporting that has to survive an examination
- Energy and utilities — metering, forecasting, and figures a public board will read
